Strategic off-market transactions, handled discreetly

For owners who want to sell a residential and commercial building, hotel or plot without offering it publicly. And for investors and family offices looking for exactly such properties.

Assess a property↓Save an acquisition profile ↓

Five services from analysis to the notary appointment

GRENFORD advises on sales and acquisitions of residential and commercial buildings, boutique hotels, plots and development projects. On one side are owners, communities of heirs and developers; on the other, private investors, family offices and project developers. You have one point of contact from the first conversation to the notarial signing.

Typical properties

Boutique hotels up to 50 roomsResidential investment buildingsPlotsSmall logistics hallsOfficeServiced ApartmentsSenior Living

Asset and transaction analysisWhat is the property worth, and who is it attractive to?＋

Rents, vacancy, operating costs, condition and location together determine the value an investor will actually pay. GRENFORD models the property the way a buyer would and shows where the upside lies: rent adjustments, extensions, conversion into condominiums or a change of use. The result is set out in the Investment Memo and forms the basis for price and buyer universe.

Land and development analysisWhat may be built, and does it pay off?＋

For plots and development projects, value starts with planning law. Together with architects and valuers from its partner network, GRENFORD reviews possible uses, building volume and an initial cost and revenue calculation. So you know which arguments to bring to talks with developers.

Discreet marketingSelling without the market finding out＋

Your property does not appear on any portal. Selected investors, family offices and developers first receive an anonymous teaser. The address, tenancy schedule and documents are only released after a non-disclosure agreement and your approval, via an organised data room.

Acquisition on behalf of clientsFinding properties that are never listed＋

Investors save an acquisition profile: asset class, region, volume, return and condition requirements. GRENFORD searches in a targeted way, approaches owners directly and presents only properties that have been reviewed beforehand.

Support up to the notarial signingDue diligence, negotiation, closing＋

GRENFORD coordinates the document review, leads the price negotiation and aligns the draft purchase agreement with the notary, lenders and both sides’ advisers through to notarisation. Legal and tax advice is provided by your lawyers and tax advisers; GRENFORD makes sure everyone is at the table at the right time.

Frequently asked questions

How is GRENFORD remunerated?＋

Success-based commission, agreed in the mandate. The initial conversation and the first assessment of your property are free of charge.

Does GRENFORD only operate in Berlin?＋

No. GRENFORD is based in Berlin and handles transactions and acquisition profiles throughout Germany.

What is a portfolio or en-bloc sale?＋

The sale of an entire property or portfolio to one buyer in a single transaction, as an asset deal or share deal, instead of selling the units individually.

How to reach GRENFORD

Contact GRENFORD confidentially about your property or acquisition profile. A non-disclosure agreement before the first exchange is of course possible.
